recipes.name: Spaghetti Pomodoro
recipes.description: A simple Italian pasta with tomato, garlic, and olive oil.
instructions: Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Boil the spaghetti until tender, then drain it well so it can absorb the sauce.
Mince the garlic finely and chop the tomato into small pieces so both cook evenly in the sauce.
Cook the garlic in olive oil, stirring briefly so it becomes fragrant without burning.
Add the tomato, stir well, and simmer until it breaks down into a sauce.
Toss the spaghetti with the sauce and basil, lifting from the bottom so everything is coated evenly.
Let the finished dish settle briefly if needed, then serve it while the texture and temperature are at their best.

recipes.name: Chicken Cacciatore
recipes.description: Italian chicken simmered with tomato, peppers, and herbs.
instructions: Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Season the chicken thigh with salt evenly, then let it sit briefly while the remaining ingredients are prepared.
Slice the onion and bell pepper evenly so it softens at the same pace.
Mince the garlic finely so the flavor spreads evenly through the dish.
Brown the chicken in olive oil, stirring or turning as needed until the surface develops good color.
Add the vegetables, tomato, and oregano, stirring well so everything is evenly distributed.
Simmer gently until the chicken is tender, stirring occasionally and watching for the texture described.
Let the finished dish settle briefly if needed, then serve it while the texture and temperature are at their best.

recipes.name: Minestrone Soup
recipes.description: A vegetable and bean soup with small pasta.
instructions: Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Dice the carrot, zucchini, and onion, keeping the pieces similar in size so they cook evenly.
Cook the onion in olive oil until soft, stirring often so it softens without burning.
Add the vegetables, tomato, white bean, and vegetable broth, stirring well so everything is evenly distributed.
Simmer gently until the vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally and watching for the texture described.
Add the small pasta and cook until done, stirring well so everything is evenly distributed.
Let the finished dish settle briefly if needed, then serve it while the texture and temperature are at their best.

recipes.name: Risotto Milanese
recipes.description: A creamy saffron risotto with Parmesan cheese.
instructions: Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Dice the onion, keeping the pieces similar in size so they cook evenly.
Cook the onion in butter until soft, stirring often so it softens without burning.
Add the arborio rice and stir until glossy, stirring well so everything is evenly distributed.
Add vegetable broth gradually while stirring, stirring well so everything is evenly distributed.
Finish with saffron and Parmesan cheese, tasting the balance before serving.
Let the finished dish settle briefly if needed, then serve it while the texture and temperature are at their best.

recipes.name: Margherita Flatbread
recipes.description: A quick Italian-style flatbread with tomato and cheese.
instructions: Preheat the oven before assembling the recipe so it is ready when the dish needs to bake.
Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Mix the plain flour, water, olive oil, and salt into a dough thoroughly, stopping when the mixture looks evenly combined.
Roll the dough into thin flatbreads, keeping the thickness even so they bake at the same speed.
Spread tomato sauce over the dough evenly, leaving the layer thin enough to heat through.
Add mozzarella cheese and basil, stirring well so everything is evenly distributed.
Bake until the cheese melts and the edges brown, checking near the end so it does not overcook.
Let the finished dish settle briefly if needed, then serve it while the texture and temperature are at their best.

recipes.name: French Onion Soup
recipes.description: A slow-cooked onion soup with melted cheese and bread.
instructions: Preheat the oven before assembling the recipe so it is ready when the dish needs to bake.
Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Slice the onions thinly and evenly so they soften and brown at the same rate.
Cook the onions in butter until deeply browned.
Add the beef broth and simmer until the mixture reaches the right texture.
Place bread over each bowl of soup carefully, spreading everything into an even layer.
Top evenly with Gruyere cheese and bake until melted so the surface browns consistently.
Let the finished dish settle briefly if needed, then serve it while the texture and temperature are at their best.

recipes.name: Ratatouille
recipes.description: A French vegetable stew with eggplant, zucchini, and tomato.
instructions: Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Dice the eggplant, zucchini, bell pepper, and onion, keeping the pieces similar in size so they cook evenly.
Mince the garlic finely so the flavor spreads evenly through the dish.
Cook the onion and garlic in olive oil, stirring until the vegetables smell fragrant and begin to soften.
Add the vegetables and tomato, stirring well so everything is evenly distributed.
Simmer gently until the vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally and watching for the texture described.
Let the finished dish settle briefly if needed, then serve it while the texture and temperature are at their best.

recipes.name: Quiche Lorraine
recipes.description: A savory French tart with eggs, cream, cheese, and pork.
instructions: Preheat the oven before assembling the recipe so it is ready when the dish needs to bake.
Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Make a pastry dough with plain flour and butter, mixing only until the dough comes together.
Press the dough into a tart pan.
Dice the pork and cook it until browned, keeping the pieces similar in size so they cook evenly.
Whisk the eggs with table cream and cheese steadily until the mixture looks smooth and evenly blended.
Fill the crust and bake until set, spreading the filling evenly before covering it.
Let the finished dish settle briefly if needed, then serve it while the texture and temperature are at their best.

recipes.name: Beef Bourguignon
recipes.description: A French beef stew cooked with vegetables and red wine.
instructions: Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Cut the beef into large, even cubes so the pieces cook at the same pace during the long simmer.
Dice the carrot and onion, keeping the pieces similar in size so they cook evenly.
Mince the garlic finely so the flavor spreads evenly through the dish.
Brown the beef in butter, stirring or turning as needed until the surface develops good color.
Add the vegetables, red wine, and beef broth, stirring well so everything is evenly distributed.
Simmer gently slowly until the beef is tender, stirring occasionally and watching for the texture described.
Let the finished dish settle briefly if needed, then serve it while the texture and temperature are at their best.

recipes.name: Salade Niçoise
recipes.description: A French salad with fish, eggs, potatoes, and vegetables.
instructions: Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Boil the potatoes until tender when pierced, then drain them well so they do not make the finished dish watery.
Boil the eggs until cooked through, cool them enough to handle, then peel them carefully.
Cook the green beans until crisp and tender.
Slice the tomato and arrange it with the other prepared ingredients so the plate is balanced and easy to serve.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, coating the ingredients lightly instead of soaking them.
Taste the final mixture and adjust only with the seasonings already listed if needed before serving.
